#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail-closed P1 delivery gate evaluation.

This module does not execute Podman, Harbor, kubectl, issue credentials, or
approve a deployment. It validates a reviewed delivery record and returns only
a deterministic pre-push/pre-deploy plan. Runtime adapters must consume the
plan without widening its scope.
"""
import copy
import re

SERVICES = ('transaction-api', 'fds-engine')
WORKFLOW_REPOSITORY = '321Team/infra-cicd'
SOURCE_REPOSITORY = '321Team/fds-msa'
HARBOR_ENDPOINT = 'https://10.1.93.54'
REGISTRY_PREFIX = '10.1.93.54/fds/'
KUBERNETES_API = 'https://10.1.93.109:6443'
NAMESPACE = 'fds-app'
SERVICE_ACCOUNT = 'ci-cd/cicd-runner-sa'
TOKEN_REQUEST_SECONDS = 900
TOKEN_MAX_SECONDS = 900
TOKEN_POLICY_REFERENCE = (
    'https://github.com/321Team/fds-project-baseline/pull/160'
    '#issuecomment-6084886811')

SHA = re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{40}')
SHA256 = re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{64}')
DIGEST = re.compile(r'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}')
REFERENCE = re.compile(r'https://github\.com/321Team/[^\s]+')
CREDENTIAL_REFERENCE = re.compile(
    r'(?:actions-secret|runner-reference|handoff-reference):[A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{1,200}')


def _obj(value):
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _text(value, limit=2000):
    return isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip()) and len(value) <= limit and \
        not any(ord(char) < 32 for char in value)


def _match(value, pattern):
    return isinstance(value, str) and pattern.fullmatch(value) is not None


def _positive_int(value):
    return type(value) is int and value > 0


def evaluate(record, phase):
    """Return BLOCK or CONDITIONS_MATCH without executing any external command."""
    reasons = []

    def need(condition, code):
        if not condition:
            reasons.append(code)

    record = copy.deepcopy(_obj(record))
    need(phase in ('pre_push', 'pre_deploy'), 'PHASE_INVALID')
    need(record.get('schema') == 'P1-CICD-delivery-gate-1', 'SCHEMA_INVALID')
    need(record.get('template_only') is False, 'TEMPLATE_OR_UNCONFIRMED_INPUT')
    need(record.get('status') == 'APPROVED_FOR_DELIVERY', 'DELIVERY_INPUT_NOT_APPROVED')

    source = _obj(record.get('source'))
    need(source.get('repository') == SOURCE_REPOSITORY, 'SOURCE_REPOSITORY_INVALID')
    need(_match(source.get('commit'), SHA), 'SOURCE_COMMIT_INVALID')
    need(_match(source.get('approval_reference'), REFERENCE), 'SOURCE_APPROVAL_REFERENCE_INVALID')

    workflow = _obj(record.get('workflow'))
    need(workflow.get('repository') == WORKFLOW_REPOSITORY, 'WORKFLOW_REPOSITORY_INVALID')
    need(workflow.get('ref') == 'refs/heads/main', 'WORKFLOW_MAIN_ONLY')
    need(_match(workflow.get('commit'), SHA), 'WORKFLOW_COMMIT_INVALID')
    need(_positive_int(workflow.get('run_id')), 'WORKFLOW_RUN_ID_INVALID')
    need(_positive_int(workflow.get('run_attempt')), 'WORKFLOW_RUN_ATTEMPT_INVALID')

    build = _obj(record.get('build_scan'))
    need(build.get('result') == 'PASS', 'BUILD_SCAN_NOT_PASS')
    need(build.get('source_commit') == source.get('commit'), 'BUILD_SOURCE_BINDING_MISMATCH')
    need(build.get('workflow_commit') == workflow.get('commit'), 'BUILD_WORKFLOW_BINDING_MISMATCH')
    need(_positive_int(build.get('run_id')), 'BUILD_RUN_ID_INVALID')
    need(_positive_int(build.get('run_attempt')), 'BUILD_RUN_ATTEMPT_INVALID')
    need(build.get('run_id') == workflow.get('run_id'), 'BUILD_RUN_BINDING_MISMATCH')
    need(build.get('run_attempt') == workflow.get('run_attempt'), 'BUILD_ATTEMPT_BINDING_MISMATCH')
    need(_match(build.get('input_sha256'), SHA256), 'BUILD_INPUT_HASH_INVALID')
    need(_match(build.get('scan_result_sha256'), SHA256), 'SCAN_RESULT_HASH_INVALID')

    images = _obj(build.get('images'))
    need(set(images) == set(SERVICES), 'EXACT_TWO_BUILD_IMAGES_REQUIRED')
    scan = _obj(build.get('scan'))
    need(set(scan) == set(SERVICES), 'EXACT_TWO_SCAN_RESULTS_REQUIRED')

    harbor = _obj(record.get('harbor'))
    need(harbor.get('endpoint') == HARBOR_ENDPOINT, 'HARBOR_ENDPOINT_INVALID')
    need(harbor.get('runner_tls_trust') == 'PASS', 'RUNNER_TLS_TRUST_NOT_PASS')
    need(harbor.get('if09_ac02') == 'PASS', 'HARBOR_IF09_AC02_NOT_PASS')
    need(_match(harbor.get('handoff_reference'), REFERENCE), 'HARBOR_HANDOFF_REFERENCE_INVALID')
    need(_match(harbor.get('credential_reference'), CREDENTIAL_REFERENCE),
         'HARBOR_CREDENTIAL_REFERENCE_INVALID')

    plans = []
    manifest_digests = []
    pushed = _obj(record.get('push'))
    targets = _obj(record.get('targets'))
    for name in SERVICES:
        image = _obj(images.get(name))
        scanned = _obj(scan.get(name))

        def check(condition, code):
            need(condition, f'{name}:{code}')

        check(_match(image.get('archive_sha256'), SHA256), 'ARCHIVE_HASH_INVALID')
        manifest = image.get('manifest_digest')
        manifest_valid = _match(manifest, DIGEST)
        if manifest_valid:
            manifest_digests.append(manifest)
        check(manifest_valid, 'MANIFEST_DIGEST_INVALID')
        check(_match(image.get('config_digest'), DIGEST), 'CONFIG_DIGEST_INVALID')
        check(scanned.get('scan') == 'PASS', 'SCAN_NOT_PASS')
        check(type(scanned.get('exit_code')) is int and scanned.get('exit_code') == 0,
              'SCAN_EXIT_CODE_NOT_ZERO')
        counts = _obj(scanned.get('counts'))
        check(set(counts) == {'HIGH', 'CRITICAL'}, 'SCAN_COUNTS_INVALID')
        check(type(counts.get('HIGH')) is int and counts.get('HIGH') == 0,
              'HIGH_FINDINGS_OR_INVALID_COUNT')
        check(type(counts.get('CRITICAL')) is int and counts.get('CRITICAL') == 0,
              'CRITICAL_FINDINGS_OR_INVALID_COUNT')
        check(scanned.get('manifest_digest') == manifest, 'SCAN_MANIFEST_MISMATCH')
        check(_match(scanned.get('report_sha256'), SHA256), 'SCAN_REPORT_HASH_INVALID')

        registry = harbor.get('repositories', {}).get(name) if isinstance(
            harbor.get('repositories'), dict) else None
        check(registry == REGISTRY_PREFIX + name, 'REGISTRY_REPOSITORY_INVALID')

        if phase == 'pre_push':
            plans.append({'service': name, 'archive_sha256': image.get('archive_sha256'),
                          'manifest_digest': manifest, 'registry_repository': registry})
            continue

        push = _obj(pushed.get(name))
        check(push.get('result') == 'PASS', 'PUSH_NOT_PASS')
        check(push.get('registry_repository') == registry, 'PUSH_REPOSITORY_MISMATCH')
        check(push.get('manifest_digest') == manifest, 'PUSH_MANIFEST_MISMATCH')
        check(_match(push.get('receipt_sha256'), SHA256), 'PUSH_RECEIPT_HASH_INVALID')

        target = _obj(targets.get(name))
        check(target.get('namespace') == NAMESPACE, 'TARGET_NAMESPACE_INVALID')
        check(target.get('deployment') == name, 'TARGET_DEPLOYMENT_INVALID')
        check(target.get('container') == name, 'TARGET_CONTAINER_INVALID')
        previous = target.get('previous_manifest_digest')
        previous_valid = _match(previous, DIGEST)
        check(previous_valid, 'ROLLBACK_DIGEST_INVALID')
        if previous_valid and manifest_valid:
            check(previous != manifest, 'ROLLBACK_DIGEST_EQUALS_NEW_DIGEST')
        plans.append({'service': name, 'namespace': NAMESPACE, 'deployment': name,
                      'container': name, 'image': registry + '@' + str(manifest),
                      'previous_manifest_digest': previous})

    need(len(manifest_digests) == len(SERVICES) and
         len(set(manifest_digests)) == len(SERVICES),
         'BUILD_MANIFEST_DIGESTS_NOT_DISTINCT')

    if phase == 'pre_deploy':
        need(set(pushed) == set(SERVICES), 'EXACT_TWO_PUSH_RESULTS_REQUIRED')
        need(set(targets) == set(SERVICES), 'EXACT_TWO_DEPLOY_TARGETS_REQUIRED')
        kubernetes = _obj(record.get('kubernetes'))
        need(kubernetes.get('api_server') == KUBERNETES_API, 'KUBERNETES_API_INVALID')
        need(kubernetes.get('service_account') == SERVICE_ACCOUNT, 'KUBERNETES_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_INVALID')
        need(kubernetes.get('rbac_scope') == 'PASS', 'KUBERNETES_RBAC_SCOPE_NOT_PASS')
        need(kubernetes.get('worker_pull') == 'PASS', 'WORKER_PULL_NOT_PASS')
        need(kubernetes.get('deployment_lock') == 'PASS', 'DEPLOYMENT_LOCK_NOT_PASS')
        ttl = kubernetes.get('token_ttl_seconds')
        need(type(ttl) is int and ttl == TOKEN_REQUEST_SECONDS,
             'TOKEN_TTL_POLICY_MISMATCH')
        need(_text(kubernetes.get('token_audience'), 500), 'TOKEN_AUDIENCE_REQUIRED')
        need(kubernetes.get('token_policy_reference') == TOKEN_POLICY_REFERENCE,
             'TOKEN_POLICY_REFERENCE_INVALID')
        approval = _obj(record.get('deployment_approval'))
        need(_text(approval.get('approved_by'), 200), 'DEPLOY_APPROVER_INVALID')
        need(_match(approval.get('reference'), REFERENCE), 'DEPLOY_APPROVAL_REFERENCE_INVALID')
        need(_positive_int(approval.get('run_id')), 'DEPLOY_APPROVAL_RUN_ID_INVALID')
        need(_positive_int(approval.get('run_attempt')), 'DEPLOY_APPROVAL_ATTEMPT_INVALID')
        need(approval.get('workflow_commit') == workflow.get('commit'),
             'DEPLOY_APPROVAL_WORKFLOW_MISMATCH')
        need(approval.get('run_id') == workflow.get('run_id'), 'DEPLOY_APPROVAL_RUN_MISMATCH')
        need(approval.get('run_attempt') == workflow.get('run_attempt'),
             'DEPLOY_APPROVAL_ATTEMPT_MISMATCH')

    return {
        'decision': 'BLOCK' if reasons else 'CONDITIONS_MATCH',
        'reasons': reasons,
        'plan': None if reasons else {'phase': phase, 'items': plans},
        'basis': 'DECLARED_REVIEWED_INPUTS_ONLY',
        'runtime_enforcement': 'NOT_INTEGRATED',
        'delivery_gate': 'NOT_VERIFIED',
        'token_audience_validation': 'PRESENCE_ONLY_NO_PINNED_APPROVED_VALUE',
    }

"""Deployment mutation core; deliberately not a runtime CLI or credential issuer.

Integration must authenticate the client, validate immutable evidence/approval,
hold the execution lock and provide durable checkpoints. This module implements
only the bounded GET/JSON-Patch state machine. See docs/deploy-adapter-core.md.
"""
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import math
import re
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass

from delivery_gate import SERVICES, NAMESPACE, REGISTRY_PREFIX


class Stop(Exception):
    """Only static error codes may be recorded; never transport exception text."""


class Rejected(Exception):
    """Transport contract: server definitively rejected PATCH without mutation.

    A timeout, disconnect, invalid success response or 5xx MUST NOT use this type.
    """


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Target:
    service: str
    uid: str
    previous_image: str
    image: str


def need(value, code):
    if not value:
        raise Stop(code)


def targets_checked(targets):
    targets = tuple(targets)
    need(len(targets) == 2 and all(isinstance(t, Target) for t in targets),
         'TARGETS_INVALID')
    need(tuple(t.service for t in targets) == SERVICES, 'TARGET_SCOPE_INVALID')
    for t in targets:
        need(isinstance(t.uid, str) and re.fullmatch(
            r'[0-9a-f]{8}-(?:[0-9a-f]{4}-){3}[0-9a-f]{12}', t.uid), 'UID_INVALID')
        pattern = re.escape(REGISTRY_PREFIX + t.service) + r'@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}'
        need(all(isinstance(i, str) and re.fullmatch(pattern, i)
                 for i in (t.previous_image, t.image)), 'IMAGE_INVALID')
        need(t.previous_image != t.image, 'NO_IMAGE_CHANGE')
    need(len({t.uid for t in targets}) == 2, 'DUPLICATE_UID')
    return targets


def inspect(obj, target, image, expected_spec=None, generation=None):
    """Check identity and complete spec; never serialize env/Secret data to receipts."""
    try:
        meta, spec = obj['metadata'], obj['spec']
        need(obj['apiVersion'] == 'apps/v1' and obj['kind'] == 'Deployment',
             'OBJECT_KIND_INVALID')
        need(meta['name'] == target.service and meta['namespace'] == NAMESPACE
             and meta['uid'] == target.uid, 'TARGET_IDENTITY_DRIFT')
        need(not meta.get('deletionTimestamp'), 'TARGET_DELETING')
        # resourceVersion is an opaque concurrency token, not an integer counter.
        rv = meta['resourceVersion']
        need(isinstance(rv, str) and 0 < len(rv) <= 200 and
             all(ord(c) >= 32 for c in rv), 'RESOURCE_VERSION_INVALID')
        need(type(meta['generation']) is int and meta['generation'] > 0,
             'GENERATION_INVALID')
        need(type(spec['replicas']) is int and spec['replicas'] > 0, 'REPLICAS_INVALID')
        need(spec.get('paused', False) is False, 'DEPLOYMENT_PAUSED')
        containers = spec['template']['spec']['containers']
        need(isinstance(containers, list) and containers, 'CONTAINERS_INVALID')
        names = [c['name'] for c in containers]
        need(len(set(names)) == len(names) and names.count(target.service) == 1,
             'CONTAINER_IDENTITY_INVALID')
        index = names.index(target.service)
        need(containers[index]['image'] == image, 'IMAGE_DRIFT')
        if expected_spec is not None:
            need(spec == expected_spec, 'SPEC_DRIFT')
        if generation is not None:
            need(meta['generation'] == generation, 'GENERATION_DRIFT')
        return index
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError):
        raise Stop('OBJECT_INVALID') from None


def ready(obj):
    """Deployment readiness only; not Pod identity, TLS, DB health or E2E."""
    status = obj.get('status', {})
    need(isinstance(status, dict), 'STATUS_INVALID')
    observed = status.get('observedGeneration')
    if type(observed) is not int or observed < obj['metadata']['generation']:
        return False
    conditions = status.get('conditions', [])
    need(isinstance(conditions, list) and all(isinstance(c, dict) for c in conditions),
         'CONDITIONS_INVALID')
    need(not any(c.get('type') == 'Progressing' and c.get('status') == 'False'
                 and c.get('reason') == 'ProgressDeadlineExceeded' for c in conditions),
         'PROGRESS_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED')
    for field in ('replicas', 'updatedReplicas', 'readyReplicas', 'availableReplicas'):
        if type(status.get(field)) is not int or status[field] != obj['spec']['replicas']:
            return False
    for field in ('unavailableReplicas', 'terminatingReplicas'):
        if type(status.get(field, 0)) is not int or status.get(field, 0) != 0:
            return False
    return True


def summary(obj, target):
    meta, spec = obj['metadata'], obj['spec']
    index = next(i for i, c in enumerate(spec['template']['spec']['containers'])
                 if c['name'] == target.service)
    return {'uid': meta['uid'], 'resource_version': meta['resourceVersion'],
            'generation': meta['generation'], 'replicas': spec['replicas'],
            'image': spec['template']['spec']['containers'][index]['image'],
            'spec_sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(
                spec, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest()}


def image_patch(obj, target, old_image, new_image):
    index = inspect(obj, target, old_image)
    base = f'/spec/template/spec/containers/{index}'
    return [
        {'op': 'test', 'path': '/metadata/uid', 'value': target.uid},
        {'op': 'test', 'path': '/metadata/resourceVersion',
         'value': obj['metadata']['resourceVersion']},
        {'op': 'test', 'path': base + '/name', 'value': target.service},
        {'op': 'test', 'path': base + '/image', 'value': old_image},
        {'op': 'replace', 'path': base + '/image', 'value': new_image},
    ]


class Adapter:
    """Single-use state machine over a caller-supplied, bounded transport.

    client.get(name) and client.patch(name, json_patch) MUST address only
    /apis/apps/v1/namespaces/fds-app/deployments/{name}. They must return decoded
    objects and enforce finite request deadlines; no retries of a PATCH.
    authorize(action) must freshly enforce reviewed inputs, lock ownership,
    execution identity and authorization expiry; rollback is a separate action.
    checkpoint(receipt) must durably save or raise *before* returning.
    remaining_seconds() must derive remaining deploy authorization from the
    verified expiry, not token TTL. The start budget is 2 * timeout + margin;
    margin must cover bounded requests/checkpoints in the integrating caller.
    credential_remaining_seconds() must derive current token lifetime from
    verified credential metadata, never from the requested TTL alone. Both
    windows must cover the start budget. Each GET/PATCH also rejects expired
    or unverifiable credentials, including rollback. The transport must bound
    individual requests by the remaining credential/approval lifetime.
    Authority denial stops all further writes, including automatic rollback.
    """

    def __init__(self, client, authorize, checkpoint, *, remaining_seconds,
                 credential_remaining_seconds,
                 window_margin=30, timeout=300, interval=2,
                 clock=time.monotonic, sleep=time.sleep):
        need(type(timeout) is int and 1 <= timeout <= 3600, 'TIMEOUT_INVALID')
        need(type(interval) is int and 1 <= interval <= timeout, 'INTERVAL_INVALID')
        need(callable(remaining_seconds), 'AUTH_WINDOW_PROVIDER_REQUIRED')
        need(type(window_margin) is int and window_margin > 0, 'WINDOW_MARGIN_INVALID')
        need(callable(credential_remaining_seconds), 'CREDENTIAL_WINDOW_PROVIDER_REQUIRED')
        self.credential_remaining_seconds = credential_remaining_seconds
        self.remaining_seconds = remaining_seconds
        self.required_window = 2 * timeout + window_margin
        self.client, self.authorize, self.checkpoint = client, authorize, checkpoint
        self.timeout, self.interval, self.clock, self.sleep = timeout, interval, clock, sleep
        self.used = False
        self.receipt = {'schema': 'P1-CICD-deploy-core-1', 'ROLLOUT': 'NOT_EXECUTED',
                        'ROLLBACK': 'NOT_EXECUTED', 'DELIVERY_GATE': 'NOT_VERIFIED',
                        'HEALTH_E2E': 'NOT_VERIFIED', 'POD_IMAGE_ID': 'NOT_VERIFIED',
                        'images': {}, 'error_code': 'NONE'}

    def save(self):
        try:
            self.checkpoint(copy.deepcopy(self.receipt))
        except Exception:
            raise Stop('CHECKPOINT_FAILED') from None

    def auth(self, action):
        try:
            need(self.authorize(action) is True, 'AUTHORIZATION_DENIED')
            need(self.credential_window() > 0, 'AUTHORIZATION_DENIED')
        except Exception:
            raise Stop('AUTHORIZATION_DENIED') from None

    def credential_window(self):
        try:
            value = self.credential_remaining_seconds()
        except Exception:
            raise Stop('CREDENTIAL_WINDOW_UNAVAILABLE') from None
        need(type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value),
             'CREDENTIAL_WINDOW_INVALID')
        return value

    def check_start_window(self):
        try:
            remaining = self.remaining_seconds()
        except Exception:
            raise Stop('AUTH_WINDOW_UNAVAILABLE') from None
        need(type(remaining) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(remaining),
             'AUTH_WINDOW_INVALID')
        need(remaining >= self.required_window, 'AUTH_WINDOW_TOO_SHORT')
        need(self.credential_window() >= self.required_window, 'CREDENTIAL_WINDOW_TOO_SHORT')

    def get(self, target, action):
        self.auth(action)
        try:
            return self.client.get(target.service)
        except Exception:
            raise Stop('GET_FAILED') from None

    def wait_ready(self, target, image, spec, generation, action):
        deadline = self.clock() + self.timeout
        while self.clock() < deadline:
            obj = self.get(target, action)
            inspect(obj, target, image, spec, generation)
            if self.clock() < deadline and ready(obj):
                return obj
            self.sleep(min(self.interval, max(0, deadline - self.clock())))
        raise Stop('READINESS_TIMEOUT')

    def mutate(self, target, before, old, new, action):
        item = self.receipt['images'][target.service]
        item[action] = 'PATCH_PENDING'
        self.save()
        try:
            self.auth(action)
            if action == 'deploy' and not any(
                    entry['deploy'] in ('APPLIED', 'READY')
                    for entry in self.receipt['images'].values()):
                self.check_start_window()
        except Stop as exc:
            item[action] = ('NOT_SENT_AUTH_DENIED' if str(exc) == 'AUTHORIZATION_DENIED'
                            else 'NOT_SENT_CREDENTIAL_WINDOW' if str(exc).startswith('CREDENTIAL_WINDOW_')
                            else 'NOT_SENT_AUTH_WINDOW')
            self.save()
            raise
        try:
            after = self.client.patch(target.service, image_patch(before, target, old, new))
        except Rejected:
            item[action] = 'REJECTED'
            self.save()
            raise Stop('PATCH_REJECTED') from None
        except Exception:
            item[action] = 'UNKNOWN'
            self.save()
            raise Stop('PATCH_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN') from None
        # An untrustworthy response cannot prove what the server actually committed.
        spec = copy.deepcopy(before['spec'])
        index = inspect(before, target, old)
        spec['template']['spec']['containers'][index]['image'] = new
        generation = before['metadata']['generation'] + 1
        try:
            inspect(after, target, new, spec, generation)
        except Stop:
            item[action] = 'UNKNOWN'
            self.save()
            raise Stop('PATCH_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN') from None
        item[action] = 'APPLIED'
        item[action + '_after'] = summary(after, target)
        self.save()
        return spec, generation

    def run(self, targets, *, rollback_on_failure=False):
        need(not self.used, 'ADAPTER_ALREADY_USED')
        self.used = True
        targets = targets_checked(targets)
        need(type(rollback_on_failure) is bool, 'ROLLBACK_OPTION_INVALID')
        baseline, applied = {}, {}
        try:
            # Check BOTH before any mutation. A bad second target cannot partially deploy.
            for target in targets:
                obj = self.get(target, 'deploy')
                inspect(obj, target, target.previous_image)
                need(ready(obj), 'BASELINE_NOT_READY')
                baseline[target.service] = copy.deepcopy(obj)
                self.receipt['images'][target.service] = {
                    'before': summary(obj, target), 'deploy': 'NOT_EXECUTED',
                    'rollback': 'NOT_EXECUTED'}
            self.check_start_window()
            self.receipt['ROLLOUT'] = 'IN_PROGRESS'
            self.save()
            for target in targets:
                initial = baseline[target.service]
                current = self.get(target, 'deploy')
                inspect(current, target, target.previous_image, initial['spec'],
                        initial['metadata']['generation'])
                state = self.mutate(target, current, target.previous_image, target.image, 'deploy')
                applied[target.service] = state
                obj = self.wait_ready(target, target.image, *state, 'deploy')
                self.receipt['images'][target.service]['deploy'] = 'READY'
                self.receipt['images'][target.service]['ready'] = summary(obj, target)
                self.save()
            # Re-check the first target after the second rollout, too.
            for target in targets:
                obj = self.get(target, 'deploy')
                inspect(obj, target, target.image, *applied[target.service])
                need(ready(obj), 'FINAL_READINESS_LOST')
            self.receipt['ROLLOUT'] = 'READY'
            self.save()
        except Stop as exc:
            code = str(exc)
            self.receipt['error_code'] = code
            self.receipt['ROLLOUT'] = 'FAILED'
            if code in ('PATCH_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN', 'CHECKPOINT_FAILED', 'AUTHORIZATION_DENIED'):
                # Authority loss must never trigger a recovery write, even if
                # rollback authority independently remains valid.
                self.receipt['ROLLBACK'] = 'MANUAL_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'
            elif rollback_on_failure and applied:
                self.rollback(targets, baseline, applied)
            elif applied:
                self.receipt['ROLLBACK'] = 'NOT_AUTHORIZED_OR_NOT_REQUESTED'
            # Failure to persist is fatal, never reported as successful recovery.
            self.save()
        return copy.deepcopy(self.receipt)

    def rollback(self, targets, baseline, applied):
        self.receipt['ROLLBACK'] = 'IN_PROGRESS'
        self.save()
        restored = {}
        try:
            for target in reversed(targets):
                if target.service not in applied:
                    continue
                current = self.get(target, 'rollback')
                inspect(current, target, target.image, *applied[target.service])
                state = self.mutate(target, current, target.image, target.previous_image, 'rollback')
                restored[target.service] = state
                self.wait_ready(target, target.previous_image, *state, 'rollback')
                self.receipt['images'][target.service]['rollback'] = 'READY'
                self.save()
            for target in targets:
                if target.service in restored:
                    spec, generation = restored[target.service]
                else:
                    spec = baseline[target.service]['spec']
                    generation = baseline[target.service]['metadata']['generation']
                current = self.get(target, 'rollback')
                inspect(current, target, target.previous_image, spec, generation)
                need(ready(current), 'ROLLBACK_READINESS_LOST')
            self.receipt['ROLLBACK'] = 'READY_HEALTH_NOT_VERIFIED'
        except Stop as exc:
            self.receipt['ROLLBACK'] = 'MANUAL_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'
            self.receipt['rollback_error_code'] = str(exc)
        self.save()

"""Pure byte-binding validator for a separate Deploy execution.

No network, credentials, approval lookup or mutation. A matching document is
not independent approval verification. Runtime integration must verify the
references and secure the expected hash/execution context out of band.
"""
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
import re

import delivery_gate as gate
from deploy_adapter import Target, targets_checked

AUDIENCE = 'https://kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local'
FIELDS = {'workflow_sha', 'run_id', 'attempt', 'repository', 'ref'}
REFERENCE = re.compile(r'https://github\.com/321Team/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/(?:issues|pull)/[1-9][0-9]*(?:#[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)?')


class Invalid(ValueError):
    pass


def need(ok, code):
    if not ok:
        raise Invalid(code)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def read(raw):
    need(type(raw) is bytes and 0 < len(raw) <= 1024 * 1024, 'BYTES_INVALID')

    def pairs(items):
        result = {}
        for key, value in items:
            need(key not in result, 'DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY')
            result[key] = value
        return result

    def constant(_):
        raise Invalid('NONFINITE_JSON')

    try:
        result = json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'), object_pairs_hook=pairs,
                            parse_constant=constant)
    except (UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, RecursionError):
        raise Invalid('JSON_INVALID') from None
    need(type(result) is dict, 'OBJECT_REQUIRED')
    return result


def identity(obj):
    need(type(obj) is dict and set(obj) == FIELDS, 'EXECUTION_FIELDS_INVALID')
    need(obj['repository'] == gate.WORKFLOW_REPOSITORY and
         obj['ref'] == 'refs/heads/main', 'EXECUTION_SCOPE_INVALID')
    need(isinstance(obj['workflow_sha'], str) and
         gate.SHA.fullmatch(obj['workflow_sha']), 'EXECUTION_SHA_INVALID')
    for field in ('run_id', 'attempt'):
        need(type(obj[field]) is int and obj[field] > 0, 'EXECUTION_NUMBER_INVALID')
    return dict(obj)


def instant(text):
    try:
        need(type(text) is str, 'TIME_INVALID')
        result = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(text)
        need(result.tzinfo is not None and result.utcoffset() is not None, 'TIMEZONE_REQUIRED')
        return result.astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, OverflowError):
        raise Invalid('TIME_INVALID') from None


def validate(raw, push_raw, expected_sha256, execution, now):
    """Return normalized targets; no boolean here authorizes a real deployment."""
    try:
        return _validate(raw, push_raw, expected_sha256, execution, now)
    except Invalid:
        raise
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError, OverflowError):
        raise Invalid('RECORD_INVALID') from None


def payload_checked(record, push_raw, actual):
    """Shared Build/Push/target checks; caller validates its own approval schema."""
    delivery = record['delivery']
    need(gate.evaluate(delivery, 'pre_push')['decision'] == 'CONDITIONS_MATCH',
         'BUILD_INPUT_BLOCKED')
    # Preserve Build identity. Never forge a pre_deploy approval bound to Build Run.
    build = delivery['workflow']
    need(actual['run_id'] != build['run_id'], 'BUILD_RUN_REUSED')
    push = read(push_raw)
    need(sha(push_raw) == record['push_receipt_sha256'], 'PUSH_HASH_MISMATCH')
    need(push.get('PUSH') == 'PASS' and push.get('error_code') == 'NONE',
         'PUSH_NOT_PASS')
    need(push['build_workflow'] == build, 'PUSH_BUILD_MISMATCH')
    expected_push = record['push_execution']
    need(type(expected_push) is dict and
         set(expected_push) == {'workflow_sha', 'run_id', 'attempt'},
         'PUSH_EXECUTION_FIELDS_INVALID')
    need(type(expected_push['workflow_sha']) is str and
         gate.SHA.fullmatch(expected_push['workflow_sha']), 'PUSH_SHA_INVALID')
    need(type(expected_push['run_id']) is str and
         re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*', expected_push['run_id']) and
         type(expected_push['attempt']) is int and expected_push['attempt'] > 0,
         'PUSH_EXECUTION_INVALID')
    context = push['execution_context']
    need(all(type(context[k]) is type(v) and context[k] == v
             for k, v in expected_push.items()), 'PUSH_EXECUTION_MISMATCH')
    need(actual['run_id'] != int(expected_push['run_id']), 'PUSH_RUN_REUSED')
    kubernetes = record['kubernetes']
    need(kubernetes['api_server'] == gate.KUBERNETES_API and
         kubernetes['service_account'] == gate.SERVICE_ACCOUNT and
         kubernetes['token_audience'] == AUDIENCE and
         type(kubernetes['token_ttl_seconds']) is int and
         kubernetes['token_ttl_seconds'] == gate.TOKEN_REQUEST_SECONDS and
         kubernetes['token_policy_reference'] == gate.TOKEN_POLICY_REFERENCE,
         'KUBERNETES_SCOPE_INVALID')
    need(set(record['targets']) == set(gate.SERVICES) and
         set(push['images']) == set(gate.SERVICES), 'EXACT_TARGETS_REQUIRED')
    targets = []
    for name in gate.SERVICES:
        target = record['targets'][name]
        image = push['images'][name]
        registry = gate.REGISTRY_PREFIX + name
        digest = delivery['build_scan']['images'][name]['manifest_digest']
        need(image['result'] == 'PASS' and image['registry_repository'] == registry
             and image['manifest_digest'] == digest, 'PUSH_IMAGE_MISMATCH')
        need(target['namespace'] == gate.NAMESPACE and
             target['deployment'] == target['container'] == name, 'TARGET_SCOPE_INVALID')
        targets.append(Target(name, target['uid'], target['previous_image'],
                              registry + '@' + digest))
    try:
        targets = targets_checked(targets)
    except Exception:
        raise Invalid('TARGET_IMAGE_OR_UID_INVALID') from None
    return dict(build), targets


def _validate(raw, push_raw, expected_sha256, execution, now):
    need(type(expected_sha256) is str and gate.SHA256.fullmatch(expected_sha256),
         'EXPECTED_HASH_INVALID')
    record = read(raw)
    need(sha(raw) == expected_sha256, 'INPUT_HASH_MISMATCH')
    need(record.get('schema') == 'P1-CICD-deploy-binding-1' and
         record.get('template_only') is False, 'SCHEMA_OR_TEMPLATE_INVALID')
    actual = identity(execution)
    need(identity(record['execution']) == actual, 'DEPLOY_EXECUTION_MISMATCH')
    build, targets = payload_checked(record, push_raw, actual)
    approval = record['approval']
    need(type(approval['reference']) is str and REFERENCE.fullmatch(approval['reference']),
         'APPROVAL_REFERENCE_INVALID')
    need(type(approval['approved_by']) is str and
         0 < len(approval['approved_by'].strip()) <= 200, 'APPROVER_INVALID')
    need(identity(approval['execution']) == actual, 'APPROVAL_EXECUTION_MISMATCH')
    need(approval['push_receipt_sha256'] == record['push_receipt_sha256'] and
         approval['targets'] == record['targets'], 'APPROVAL_INPUT_MISMATCH')
    # Bind both directions explicitly, not just previous digests.
    approved_images = {t.service: t.image for t in targets}
    need(approval['images'] == approved_images, 'APPROVAL_IMAGE_MISMATCH')
    need(type(approval['allow_rollback']) is bool, 'ROLLBACK_SCOPE_INVALID')
    start, end = instant(approval['not_before']), instant(approval['expires_at'])
    need(isinstance(now, dt.datetime) and now.tzinfo is not None and
         now.utcoffset() is not None, 'NOW_INVALID')
    need(start < end and start <= now < end, 'APPROVAL_WINDOW_INVALID')
    return {'binding': 'MATCH', 'basis': 'SUPPLIED_BYTES_AND_DECLARED_APPROVAL',
            'approval_verification': 'NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED',
            'runtime_enforcement': 'NOT_INTEGRATED', 'delivery_gate': 'NOT_VERIFIED',
            'input_sha256': expected_sha256, 'push_receipt_sha256': sha(push_raw),
            'execution': actual, 'build_workflow': dict(build),
            'targets': targets, 'expires_at': end,
            'remaining_seconds': (end - now).total_seconds(),
            'allow_rollback': approval['allow_rollback']}

"""CP1-only existing-auth access: TokenReview, named reads, failing dry-run test.

No issuance, kubeconfig export, RBAC changes, image patch or token logging.
Subprocess output is held in memory; only allowlisted observations may be emitted.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import socket
import stat
import subprocess
import time
import urllib.parse

import deploy_binding as b
import deploy_credential as c
import deploy_transport as t

MAX_BYTES = 1024 * 1024
NAMES = ('transaction-api', 'fds-engine')
ZERO_UID = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'


class AccessError(RuntimeError):
    """Static codes; do not forward command output or exception messages."""


def need(ok, code):
    if not ok:
        raise AccessError(code)


def host_checked(mode):
    need(os.name == 'posix', 'POSIX_HOST_REQUIRED')
    import pwd
    user = pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_name
    host = socket.gethostname().split('.')[0]
    if mode == 'cp1':
        need(host == 'k8s-control01' and user == 'server02', 'CP1_IDENTITY_MISMATCH')
    elif mode == 'runner':
        need(host == 'cicd-runner01' and user == 'server01_cicd-runner'
             and os.getuid() == 1000, 'RUNNER_IDENTITY_MISMATCH')
    else:
        raise AccessError('HOST_MODE_INVALID')


def path_checked(path, *, regular=True):
    path = Path(path)
    need(path.is_absolute(), 'ABSOLUTE_PATH_REQUIRED')
    for node in path.parents:
        info = node.lstat()
        need(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and info.st_uid in (0, os.getuid())
             and not info.st_mode & 0o022, 'UNSAFE_PARENT')
    info = path.lstat()
    need((stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) if regular else stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode))
         and info.st_uid in (0, os.getuid()) and not info.st_mode & 0o022
         and (not regular or info.st_nlink == 1), 'UNSAFE_FILE')
    return info


def read_checked(path):
    try:
        before = path_checked(path)
        need(0 < before.st_size <= MAX_BYTES, 'FILE_SIZE_INVALID')
        fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'rb') as stream:
            opened = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino) == (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino),
                 'FILE_CHANGED')
            raw = stream.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)
            final = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        after = path_checked(path)
        snapshot = lambda s: (s.st_dev, s.st_ino, s.st_size, s.st_mtime_ns, s.st_ctime_ns)
        need(snapshot(before) == snapshot(final) == snapshot(after), 'FILE_CHANGED')
        need(0 < len(raw) <= MAX_BYTES, 'FILE_SIZE_INVALID')
        return raw
    except AccessError:
        raise
    except Exception:
        raise AccessError('FILE_READ_FAILED') from None


def ca_checked(path, expected_hash):
    raw = read_checked(path)
    try:
        context = t.context_checked(raw, expected_hash)
    except Exception:
        raise AccessError('PINNED_CA_INVALID') from None
    return raw, context


def timeout_checked(value):
    need(type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value) and 0 < value <= 10,
         'TIMEOUT_INVALID')
    return float(value)


def request_url_checked(url, name):
    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
    query = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed.query, keep_blank_values=True, strict_parsing=True)
    need(parsed.scheme == 'https' and parsed.netloc == '10.1.93.109:6443'
         and not parsed.fragment
         and parsed.path == '/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/fds-app/deployments/' + name
         and query.get('dryRun') == ['All']
         and set(query) <= {'dryRun', 'fieldManager', 'fieldValidation', 'timeout'}
         and all(len(values) == 1 and 0 < len(values[0]) <= 100 for values in query.values()),
         'PROBE_REQUEST_SCOPE_INVALID')


def status_projection(stderr, name):
    """Bind one PATCH request/HTTP status/body; ignore completed discovery bodies."""
    need(name in NAMES, 'DEPLOYMENT_SCOPE_INVALID')
    need(type(stderr) is bytes and len(stderr) <= MAX_BYTES, 'PROBE_LOG_INVALID')
    # client-go v0.36.4 v8 emits Request(verb/url), Response(status), Response Body.
    quoted = r'"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"'
    request_pattern = re.compile(r'"Request" verb=(' + quoted + r') url=(' + quoted + r')(?=\s|$)')
    response_pattern = re.compile(r'"Response" status=(' + quoted + r')(?=\s|$)')
    pending_requests = pending_bodies = targets = 0
    active, http_code, selected = False, None, None
    try:
        lines = iter(stderr.decode('utf-8').split('\n'))
        for line in lines:
            if '"Request" ' in line:
                match = request_pattern.search(line)
                need(match is not None, 'PROBE_TRACE_INVALID')
                verb, url = (json.loads(value) for value in match.groups())
                need(not active, 'PROBE_TRACE_INTERLEAVED')
                if verb == 'PATCH':
                    request_url_checked(url, name)
                    need(targets == 0 and pending_requests == pending_bodies == 0,
                         'PROBE_TRACE_AMBIGUOUS')
                    targets += 1
                    active, http_code = True, None
                pending_requests += 1
                continue
            if '"Response" ' in line:
                match = response_pattern.search(line)
                need(match is not None and pending_requests > 0, 'PROBE_TRACE_INVALID')
                pending_requests -= 1
                pending_bodies += 1
                if active:
                    status = json.loads(match.group(1))
                    need(http_code is None and re.fullmatch(r'(409|422) [^\r\n]+', status),
                         'PROBE_HTTP_STATUS_INVALID')
                    http_code = int(status[:3])
                continue
            structured = '"Response Body"' in line and ' body=' in line
            legacy = 'Response Body: ' in line
            if not structured and not legacy:
                continue
            need(pending_bodies > 0, 'PROBE_TRACE_INVALID')
            pending_bodies -= 1
            hash_basis = 'LOG_BODY_DECODED'
            if structured:
                fragment = line.split(' body=', 1)[1]
                if fragment == '<':
                    chunks = []
                    for continuation in lines:
                        if continuation == ' >':
                            break
                        need(continuation.startswith('\t'), 'PROBE_BODY_INVALID')
                        chunks.append(continuation[1:])
                    else:
                        raise AccessError('PROBE_BODY_INVALID')
                    need(bool(chunks), 'PROBE_BODY_INVALID')
                    # klog cannot distinguish whether the original last LF existed.
                    raw = ('\n'.join(chunks) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
                    hash_basis = 'KLOG_NORMALIZED_TRAILING_LF'
                else:
                    body, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(fragment)
                    need(type(body) is str and not fragment[end:].strip(), 'PROBE_BODY_INVALID')
                    raw = body.encode('utf-8')
            else:
                raw = line.split('Response Body: ', 1)[1].encode('utf-8')
            if not active:
                # Consume discovery blocks; never interpret their rows as log events.
                continue
            need(http_code is not None, 'PROBE_TRACE_INVALID')
            need(b'[truncated ' not in raw, 'PROBE_BODY_TRUNCATED')
            obj = b.read(raw)
            need(obj.get('kind') == 'Status' and obj.get('status') == 'Failure'
                 and obj.get('apiVersion') == 'v1' and type(obj.get('code')) is int
                 and obj['code'] == http_code
                 and obj.get('reason') in ('Conflict', 'Invalid'), 'PROBE_STATUS_INVALID')
            selected, active = (raw, obj, hash_basis), False
        need(targets == 1 and selected is not None and not active
             and pending_requests == pending_bodies == 0, 'PROBE_STATUS_UNCONFIRMED')
        raw, obj, hash_basis = selected
        result = {key: obj[key] for key in ('apiVersion', 'kind', 'status', 'code', 'reason')}
        if 'details' in obj:
            details = obj['details']
            need(type(details) is dict, 'PROBE_DETAILS_INVALID')
            allowed = {'name': (name,), 'namespace': ('fds-app',),
                       'group': ('apps',), 'kind': ('deployments',)}
            result['details'] = {
                key: details[key] if details[key] in choices else 'MISMATCH'
                for key, choices in allowed.items() if key in details
            }
        return {'status_projection': result, 'status_body_sha256': b.sha(raw),
                'status_body_hash_basis': hash_basis,
                'payload': 'ALLOWLISTED_PROJECTION_ONLY', 'transport_policy': 'UNCHANGED',
                'response_binding': 'PATCH_REQUEST_HTTP_STATUS_BODY',
                'request_path': '/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/fds-app/deployments/' + name}
    except AccessError:
        raise
    except Exception:
        raise AccessError('PROBE_BODY_INVALID') from None


class CP1Access:
    def __init__(self, ca_path, expected_ca_sha256, *, clock=time.monotonic):
        host_checked('cp1')
        self.clock, self.blocked = clock, False
        self.ca_path, self.ca_hash = str(Path(ca_path)), expected_ca_sha256
        self.ca_raw, _ = ca_checked(self.ca_path, self.ca_hash)
        self.binary = shutil.which('kubectl')
        need(self.binary is not None and Path(self.binary).is_absolute(), 'KUBECTL_MISSING')
        self.binary_info = path_checked(self.binary)
        need(os.access(self.binary, os.X_OK), 'KUBECTL_NOT_EXECUTABLE')
        configured = os.environ.get('KUBECONFIG')
        need(configured is None or (configured and ':' not in configured),
             'SINGLE_KUBECONFIG_REQUIRED')
        self.config_path = str(Path(configured) if configured else Path.home() / '.kube/config')
        self.config_hash = b.sha(read_checked(self.config_path))
        self.env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
                    if key.lower() not in ('http_proxy', 'https_proxy', 'all_proxy')}
        self.env['KUBECTL_KUBERC'] = 'false'
        self.context, self.auth_files = None, []
        deadline = self.clock() + 10
        self.inspect_config(deadline)

    def budget(self, deadline):
        value = deadline - self.clock()
        need(math.isfinite(value) and value > 0, 'ACCESS_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED')
        return min(value, 10)

    def files_checked(self):
        current = path_checked(self.binary)
        need((current.st_dev, current.st_ino, current.st_mtime_ns, current.st_ctime_ns) ==
             (self.binary_info.st_dev, self.binary_info.st_ino,
              self.binary_info.st_mtime_ns, self.binary_info.st_ctime_ns),
             'KUBECTL_CHANGED')
        need(b.sha(read_checked(self.config_path)) == self.config_hash, 'KUBECONFIG_CHANGED')
        need(read_checked(self.ca_path) == self.ca_raw, 'CA_CHANGED')
        for path, digest in self.auth_files:
            need(b.sha(read_checked(path)) == digest, 'CLIENT_AUTH_FILE_CHANGED')

    def arguments_checked(self, args, payload, verbosity, allow_failure):
        config = ['config', 'view', '--minify', '-o', 'json']
        sa = ['get', 'serviceaccount', 'cicd-runner-sa', '-n', 'ci-cd', '-o', 'json']
        review = ['create', '--raw=/apis/authentication.k8s.io/v1/tokenreviews', '-f', '-']
        reads = [['get', 'deployment', name, '-n', 'fds-app', '-o', 'json'] for name in NAMES]
        patch = json.dumps([{'op': 'test', 'path': '/metadata/uid', 'value': ZERO_UID}],
                           separators=(',', ':'))
        probes = [['patch', 'deployment', name, '-n', 'fds-app', '--type=json',
                   '--dry-run=server', '-p', patch, '-o', 'json'] for name in NAMES]
        if args == config or args == sa or args in reads:
            need(payload is None and verbosity == 0 and not allow_failure,
                 'COMMAND_SCOPE_INVALID')
        elif args == review:
            obj = b.read(payload)
            need(set(obj) == {'apiVersion', 'kind', 'spec'}
                 and obj['apiVersion'] == 'authentication.k8s.io/v1'
                 and obj['kind'] == 'TokenReview' and type(obj['spec']) is dict
                 and set(obj['spec']) == {'token', 'audiences'}
                 and obj['spec']['audiences'] == [b.AUDIENCE]
                 and type(obj['spec']['token']) is str
                 and 0 < len(obj['spec']['token']) <= 16384
                 and re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', obj['spec']['token'])
                 and verbosity == 0 and not allow_failure, 'COMMAND_SCOPE_INVALID')
        else:
            need(args in probes and payload is None and verbosity == 8 and allow_failure,
                 'COMMAND_SCOPE_INVALID')

    def command(self, args, deadline, *, payload=None, verbosity=0, allow_failure=False):
        need(not self.blocked, 'ACCESS_BLOCKED')
        try:
            self.arguments_checked(args, payload, verbosity, allow_failure)
            self.files_checked()
            command = [self.binary, '--kubeconfig=' + self.config_path, '--v=' + str(verbosity)]
            if self.context is not None:
                command += ['--context=' + self.context, '--server=' + t.API_SERVER,
                            '--certificate-authority=' + self.ca_path,
                            '--tls-server-name=' + t.HOST,
                            '--request-timeout=' + str(self.budget(deadline)) + 's']
            result = subprocess.run(command + args, input=payload, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                    stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=self.budget(deadline),
                                    env=self.env, check=False)
            self.budget(deadline)
            self.files_checked()
            need(type(result.stdout) is bytes and type(result.stderr) is bytes and
                 len(result.stdout) <= MAX_BYTES and len(result.stderr) <= MAX_BYTES,
                 'COMMAND_OUTPUT_INVALID')
            need(allow_failure or result.returncode == 0, 'KUBECTL_FAILED')
            return result
        except Exception as exc:
            self.blocked = True
            if isinstance(exc, AccessError):
                raise
            raise AccessError('KUBECTL_FAILED') from None

    def inspect_config(self, deadline):
        result = self.command(['config', 'view', '--minify', '-o', 'json'], deadline)
        try:
            cfg = b.read(result.stdout)
            need(len(cfg.get('clusters', [])) == len(cfg.get('users', [])) ==
                 len(cfg.get('contexts', [])) == 1, 'CONFIG_SELECTION_INVALID')
            cluster_item, user_item, context_item = (
                cfg['clusters'][0], cfg['users'][0], cfg['contexts'][0])
            cluster, user, context = (
                cluster_item['cluster'], user_item['user'], context_item['context'])
            name = context_item['name']
            need(type(name) is str and 0 < len(name) <= 200 and
                 all(ord(x) >= 32 for x in name) and cfg.get('current-context') == name
                 and context.get('cluster') == cluster_item['name']
                 and context.get('user') == user_item['name'], 'CONFIG_SELECTION_INVALID')
            need(cluster.get('server') == t.API_SERVER
                 and not cluster.get('insecure-skip-tls-verify', False)
                 and cluster.get('tls-server-name', t.HOST) in ('', t.HOST)
                 and not cluster.get('proxy-url'), 'CONFIG_TLS_INVALID')
            need(not any(key in user for key in (
                'exec', 'auth-provider', 'token', 'tokenFile', 'username', 'password',
                'as', 'as-uid', 'as-groups', 'as-user-extra')), 'CLIENT_AUTH_UNSUPPORTED')
            files = []
            for prefix in ('client-certificate', 'client-key'):
                embedded, filename = user.get(prefix + '-data'), user.get(prefix)
                need(bool(embedded) != bool(filename), 'CLIENT_CERT_AUTH_REQUIRED')
                if embedded:
                    need(type(embedded) is str, 'CLIENT_CERT_AUTH_REQUIRED')
                if filename:
                    need(type(filename) is str, 'CLIENT_AUTH_PATH_INVALID')
                    files.append((filename, b.sha(read_checked(filename))))
            if self.context is not None:
                need(name == self.context and files == self.auth_files, 'CONFIG_CHANGED')
            self.context, self.auth_files = name, files
        except Exception as exc:
            self.blocked = True
            if isinstance(exc, AccessError):
                raise
            raise AccessError('CONFIG_INVALID') from None

    def request(self, args, *, payload=None, timeout=10, verbosity=0, allow_failure=False):
        try:
            deadline = self.clock() + timeout_checked(timeout)
            need(not self.blocked, 'ACCESS_BLOCKED')
            self.inspect_config(deadline)

                                allow_failure=allow_failure)
        except Exception:

    def service_account_uid(self):
        try:
            result = self.request(['get', 'serviceaccount', 'cicd-runner-sa', '-n', 'ci-cd',
                                   '-o', 'json'])

            meta = obj.get('metadata', {})
            need(obj.get('apiVersion') == 'v1' and obj.get('kind') == 'ServiceAccount'
                 and meta.get('name') == 'cicd-runner-sa' and meta.get('namespace') == 'ci-cd'
                 and type(meta.get('uid')) is str and c.UID.fullmatch(meta['uid'])

    def deployment(self, name):

        result = self.request(['get', 'deployment', name, '-n', 'fds-app', '-o', 'json'])

        except Exception:

                'DEPLOY': 'NOT_EXECUTED', 'DELIVERY_GATE': 'NOT_VERIFIED'})

        except Exception:
            self.blocked = True
            raise AccessError('NEGATIVE_TEST_UNCONFIRMED') from None

"""Injected native ServiceAccount JWT lifetime and local cleanup contract.

A reviewed caller must supply a fresh TokenReview backend over authenticated,
pinned Kubernetes TLS. This module neither implements that backend nor issues,
stores, refreshes or revokes a token. Decoding alone never creates a Credential.
"""
import base64
import copy
import datetime as dt
import math
import re
import time

import deploy_binding as b

SUBJECT = 'system:serviceaccount:ci-cd:cicd-runner-sa'
GROUPS = {'system:serviceaccounts', 'system:serviceaccounts:ci-cd', 'system:authenticated'}
UID = re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{8}-(?:[0-9a-f]{4}-){3}[0-9a-f]{12}')


class CredentialError(RuntimeError):
    """Static codes only; never propagate token or backend response text."""


def need(ok, code):
    if not ok:
        raise CredentialError(code)


def segment(raw):
    need(type(raw) is str and 0 < len(raw) <= 16384 and
         re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]+', raw), 'JWT_ENCODING_INVALID')
    try:
        decoded = base64.b64decode(raw + '=' * (-len(raw) % 4), altchars=b'-_', validate=True)
        need(base64.urlsafe_b64encode(decoded).decode().rstrip('=') == raw,
             'JWT_ENCODING_INVALID')
        return decoded
    except CredentialError:
        raise
    except Exception:
        raise CredentialError('JWT_ENCODING_INVALID') from None


def claims_checked(token, expected_uid):
    need(type(token) is str and 0 < len(token) <= 16384, 'CREDENTIAL_INVALID')
    need(type(expected_uid) is str and UID.fullmatch(expected_uid), 'SA_UID_INVALID')
    parts = token.split('.')
    need(len(parts) == 3, 'JWT_ENCODING_INVALID')
    try:
        header, claims = b.read(segment(parts[0])), b.read(segment(parts[1]))
        need(header.get('alg') in ('RS256', 'ES256') and bool(segment(parts[2])),
             'JWT_ALGORITHM_UNSUPPORTED')
        need(claims.get('iss') == b.AUDIENCE and claims.get('sub') == SUBJECT,
             'JWT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH')
        need(claims.get('aud') == [b.AUDIENCE], 'JWT_AUDIENCE_MISMATCH')
        for field in ('exp', 'iat', 'nbf'):
            need(type(claims.get(field)) is int and 0 < claims[field] <= 253402300799,
                 'JWT_TIME_INVALID')
        need(claims['nbf'] <= claims['iat'] < claims['exp']
             and claims['exp'] - claims['iat'] <= b.gate.TOKEN_MAX_SECONDS,
             'JWT_LIFETIME_INVALID')
        kubernetes = claims['kubernetes.io']
        account = kubernetes['serviceaccount']
        need(kubernetes['namespace'] == 'ci-cd' and account['name'] == 'cicd-runner-sa'
             and account['uid'] == expected_uid, 'JWT_SA_MISMATCH')
        return claims
    except CredentialError:
        raise
    except Exception:
        raise CredentialError('JWT_CLAIMS_INVALID') from None


def review_checked(result, token, uid):
    # The backend, not this dict validator, must authenticate the API response.
    try:
        need(type(result) is dict and result.get('apiVersion') == 'authentication.k8s.io/v1'
             and result.get('kind') == 'TokenReview', 'TOKEN_REVIEW_INVALID')
        spec, status = result['spec'], result['status']
        need(spec.get('token') == token and spec.get('audiences') == [b.AUDIENCE],
             'TOKEN_REVIEW_BINDING_MISMATCH')
        need(status.get('authenticated') is True and not status.get('error'),
             'TOKEN_REVIEW_DENIED')
        need(status.get('audiences') == [b.AUDIENCE], 'TOKEN_REVIEW_AUDIENCE_MISMATCH')
        user = status['user']
        need(user.get('username') == SUBJECT and user.get('uid') == uid,
             'TOKEN_REVIEW_IDENTITY_MISMATCH')
        groups = user.get('groups')
        need(type(groups) is list and all(type(x) is str for x in groups)
             and len(groups) == len(GROUPS) and set(groups) == GROUPS,
             'TOKEN_REVIEW_GROUPS_INVALID')
    except CredentialError:
        raise
    except Exception:
        raise CredentialError('TOKEN_REVIEW_INVALID') from None


class Credential:
    """Single injected credential. close() drops only our local reference."""
    __slots__ = ('_token', '_expiry', '_mono_expiry', '_last_clock', '_now',
                 '_clock', '_metadata', 'closed')

    def __init__(self, token, expected_sa_uid, reviewer, *,
                 now=lambda: dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc), clock=time.monotonic,
                 review_timeout=10):
        self._token, self.closed = None, True
        self._now, self._clock = now, clock
        need(callable(now) and callable(clock) and
             callable(getattr(reviewer, 'review', None)), 'CREDENTIAL_PROVIDER_REQUIRED')
        need(type(review_timeout) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(review_timeout)
             and 0 < review_timeout <= 10, 'TOKEN_REVIEW_BUDGET_INVALID')
        claims = claims_checked(token, expected_sa_uid)
        current, initial = self.point()
        need(claims['nbf'] <= current.timestamp() and claims['iat'] <= current.timestamp(),
             'CREDENTIAL_NOT_YET_VALID')
        self._expiry = dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(claims['exp'], dt.timezone.utc)
        lifetime = (self._expiry - current).total_seconds()
        need(lifetime > 0, 'CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED')
        budget = min(review_timeout, lifetime)
        # This initial monotonic bound is never reset after a delayed review.
        self._mono_expiry, self._last_clock = initial + lifetime, initial
        try:
            result = reviewer.review(token, b.AUDIENCE, budget)
        except Exception:
            raise CredentialError('TOKEN_REVIEW_FAILED') from None
        review_checked(result, token, expected_sa_uid)
        checked_at, finished = self.point()
        need(initial <= finished <= initial + budget, 'TOKEN_REVIEW_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED')
        need(min((self._expiry - checked_at).total_seconds(), self._mono_expiry - finished) > 0,
             'CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED')
        self._metadata = {
            'schema': 'P1-CICD-credential-observation-1',
            'subject': SUBJECT, 'service_account_uid': expected_sa_uid,
            'issuer': b.AUDIENCE, 'audience': b.AUDIENCE,
            'issued_at': dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(claims['iat'], dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            'expires_at': self._expiry.isoformat(), 'checked_at': checked_at.isoformat(),
            'authentication_basis': 'CALLER_AUTHENTICATED_FRESH_TOKEN_REVIEW',
            'jwt_signature_check': 'NOT_PERFORMED_LOCALLY',
            'runner_token_authentication': 'NOT_VERIFIED',
            'server_revocation': 'NOT_PERFORMED', 'DELIVERY_GATE': 'NOT_VERIFIED',
        }
        self._last_clock, self._token, self.closed = finished, token, False

    def point(self):
        try:
            wall, mono = self._now(), self._clock()
            need(isinstance(wall, dt.datetime) and wall.tzinfo is not None
                 and wall.utcoffset() is not None, 'CREDENTIAL_TIME_INVALID')
            need(type(mono) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(mono),
                 'CREDENTIAL_CLOCK_INVALID')
            return wall.astimezone(dt.timezone.utc), mono
        except CredentialError:
            raise
        except Exception:
            raise CredentialError('CREDENTIAL_CLOCK_UNAVAILABLE') from None

    def remaining(self):
        if self.closed or self._token is None:
            return 0
        try:
            wall, mono = self.point()
            need(mono >= self._last_clock, 'CREDENTIAL_CLOCK_BACKWARD')
            self._last_clock = mono
            remaining = max(0, min((self._expiry - wall).total_seconds(), self._mono_expiry - mono))
            if remaining == 0:
                self.close()
            return remaining
        except Exception:
            self.close()
            raise CredentialError('CREDENTIAL_WINDOW_UNAVAILABLE') from None

    def token(self):
        need(self._token is not None and self.remaining() > 0, 'CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE')
        return self._token

    def observation(self):
        result = copy.deepcopy(self._metadata)
        result['local_credential_cleanup'] = (
            'LOCAL_REFERENCE_DROPPED' if self.closed else 'NOT_PERFORMED')
        return result

    def close(self):
        self._token, self.closed = None, True

    def __repr__(self):
        return '<Credential closed=' + str(self.closed) + '>'

    def __enter__(self):
        need(self.remaining() > 0, 'CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE')
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *_):
        self.close()
        return False

"""One native SA candidate, fresh CP1 reviews, Runner GET/SSAR; no rollout.

Endpoint stdout is a PRIVATE SSH protocol, never terminal output or evidence.
Tokens and raw TokenReview responses remain in bounded memory/pipe frames.
"""
import datetime as dt
import http.client
import json
import math
import os
import re
import select
import socket
import stat
import time

import deploy_binding as b
import deploy_cp1_access as a
import deploy_credential as c
import deploy_transport as t

TOKEN_PATH = '/api/v1/namespaces/ci-cd/serviceaccounts/cicd-runner-sa/token'
TOKEN_ARGS = ['create', '--raw=' + TOKEN_PATH, '-f', '-']
SA_ARGS = ['get', 'serviceaccount', 'cicd-runner-sa', '-n', 'ci-cd', '-o', 'json']
SSAR_PATH = '/apis/authorization.k8s.io/v1/selfsubjectaccessreviews'
SSAR_ARGS = ['create', '--raw=' + SSAR_PATH, '-f', '-']
CP1_PERMISSIONS = (
    {'verb': 'create', 'group': '', 'version': 'v1', 'resource': 'serviceaccounts',
     'subresource': 'token', 'name': 'cicd-runner-sa', 'namespace': 'ci-cd'},
    {'verb': 'create', 'group': 'authentication.k8s.io', 'version': 'v1', 'resource': 'tokenreviews'},
)
TTL = b.gate.TOKEN_REQUEST_SECONDS
MAX_FRAME = 1024 * 1024


class ProbeError(RuntimeError):
    """Static codes only."""


def need(ok, code):
    if not ok:
        raise ProbeError(code)


def encode(obj):
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True,
                      separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode('ascii')


def review_attributes_match(obj, attrs):
    spec = obj.get('spec')
    if type(spec) is not dict or set(spec) != {'resourceAttributes'}:
        return False
    actual = spec['resourceAttributes']
    if type(actual) is not dict:
        return False
    # ResourceAttributes.group has omitempty; core API group "" is omitted.
    normalized = {'group': '', **actual}
    return normalized == attrs


def expiry(raw):
    need(type(raw) is str and re.fullmatch(
        r'\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d(?:\.\d{1,6})?(?:Z|\+00:00)', raw),
        'UTC_EXPIRY_REQUIRED')
    value = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(raw.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
    need(value.utcoffset() == dt.timedelta(0), 'UTC_EXPIRY_REQUIRED')
    return value


def utcnow():
    return dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)


class Window:
    def __init__(self, raw, *, now=lambda: dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc),
                 clock=time.monotonic):
        self.now, self.clock, self.expires = now, clock, expiry(raw)
        left = (self.expires - now()).total_seconds()
        need(0 < left <= 3600, 'PROBE_AUTHORIZATION_WINDOW_INVALID')
        self.deadline, self.last = clock() + left, clock()

    def remaining(self):
        point = self.clock()
        need(point >= self.last, 'PROBE_CLOCK_REVERSED')
        self.last = point
        value = min(self.deadline - point, (self.expires - self.now()).total_seconds())
        need(value > 0, 'PROBE_AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED')
        return value


class Channel:
    """Bounded LF-framed JSON over POSIX pipes. No secret-bearing repr/logging."""
    def __init__(self, reader, writer, *, clock=time.monotonic):
        self.reader, self.writer, self.clock = reader, writer, clock
        self.buffer = bytearray()
        os.set_blocking(reader, False)
        os.set_blocking(writer, False)

    def wait(self, write, deadline):
        remaining = deadline - self.clock()
        need(remaining > 0, 'CHANNEL_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED')
        ready = select.select([] if write else [self.reader],
                              [self.writer] if write else [], [], remaining)
        need(bool(ready[1] if write else ready[0]), 'CHANNEL_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED')

    def send_raw(self, raw, timeout=10):
        need(type(raw) is bytes and 0 < len(raw) <= MAX_FRAME and b'\n' not in raw,
             'CHANNEL_FRAME_INVALID')
        need(type(timeout) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(timeout) and 0 < timeout <= 180,
             'CHANNEL_TIMEOUT_INVALID')
        frame, offset, deadline = raw + b'\n', 0, self.clock() + timeout
        try:
            while offset < len(frame):
                self.wait(True, deadline)
                try:
                    count = os.write(self.writer, frame[offset:offset + 4096])
                except BlockingIOError:
                    continue
                need(count > 0, 'CHANNEL_CLOSED')
                offset += count
            need(self.clock() <= deadline, 'CHANNEL_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED')
        finally:
            frame = None

    def send(self, obj, timeout=10):
        self.send_raw(encode(obj), timeout)

    def recv(self, timeout=10):
        need(type(timeout) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(timeout) and 0 < timeout <= 180,
             'CHANNEL_TIMEOUT_INVALID')
        deadline = self.clock() + timeout
        try:
            while b'\n' not in self.buffer:
                need(len(self.buffer) <= MAX_FRAME, 'CHANNEL_FRAME_TOO_LARGE')
                self.wait(False, deadline)
                try:
                    part = os.read(self.reader, min(65536, MAX_FRAME + 1 - len(self.buffer)))
                except BlockingIOError:
                    continue
                need(bool(part), 'CHANNEL_CLOSED')
                self.buffer.extend(part)
            line, rest = self.buffer.split(b'\n', 1)
            self.buffer = bytearray(rest)
            need(0 < len(line) <= MAX_FRAME and self.clock() <= deadline,
                 'CHANNEL_FRAME_INVALID')
            return b.read(bytes(line))
        except Exception:
            self.buffer.clear()
            raise

    def clear(self):
        self.buffer.clear()  # Logical release, not physical zeroization.


class NativeAccess(a.CP1Access):
    """Isolated extension; the existing CP1Access allowlist is unchanged."""
    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.attempted, self.issue_uid, self.token_command_seen = False, None, False

    def sa_uid(self, timeout=10):
        obj = b.read(self.request(SA_ARGS, timeout=timeout).stdout)
        meta = obj.get('metadata', {})
        need(obj.get('apiVersion') == 'v1' and obj.get('kind') == 'ServiceAccount'
             and meta.get('name') == 'cicd-runner-sa' and meta.get('namespace') == 'ci-cd'
             and type(meta.get('uid')) is str and c.UID.fullmatch(meta['uid'])
             and not meta.get('deletionTimestamp')
             and obj.get('automountServiceAccountToken') is False, 'SA_IDENTITY_INVALID')
        return meta['uid']

    def preflight(self):
        uid = self.sa_uid()
        for attrs in CP1_PERMISSIONS:
            body = {'apiVersion': 'authorization.k8s.io/v1', 'kind': 'SelfSubjectAccessReview',
                    'spec': {'resourceAttributes': attrs}}
            obj = b.read(self.request(SSAR_ARGS, payload=encode(body)).stdout)
            status = obj.get('status', {})
            need(obj.get('apiVersion') == body['apiVersion'] and obj.get('kind') == body['kind']
                 and review_attributes_match(obj, attrs) and status.get('allowed') is True
                 and status.get('denied', False) is False and not status.get('evaluationError'),
                 'CP1_ISSUANCE_PERMISSION_UNCONFIRMED')
        return uid

    def arguments_checked(self, args, payload, verbosity, allow_failure):
        if args == SSAR_ARGS:
            obj = b.read(payload)
            need(verbosity == 0 and allow_failure is False
                 and set(obj) == {'apiVersion', 'kind', 'spec'}
                 and obj['apiVersion'] == 'authorization.k8s.io/v1'
                 and obj['kind'] == 'SelfSubjectAccessReview'
                 and set(obj['spec']) == {'resourceAttributes'}
                 and obj['spec']['resourceAttributes'] in CP1_PERMISSIONS,
                 'CP1_SSAR_SCOPE_INVALID')
            return
        if args != TOKEN_ARGS:
            return super().arguments_checked(args, payload, verbosity, allow_failure)
        need(self.attempted and not self.token_command_seen
             and type(self.issue_uid) is str and c.UID.fullmatch(self.issue_uid)
             and verbosity == 0 and allow_failure is False, 'ISSUANCE_SCOPE_INVALID')
        need(b.read(payload) == {
            'apiVersion': 'authentication.k8s.io/v1', 'kind': 'TokenRequest',
            'metadata': {'name': 'cicd-runner-sa', 'namespace': 'ci-cd', 'uid': self.issue_uid},
            'spec': {'audiences': [b.AUDIENCE], 'expirationSeconds': TTL},
        }, 'ISSUANCE_BODY_INVALID')
        self.token_command_seen = True

    def issue(self, expected_uid, remaining_seconds):
        need(not self.attempted, 'ISSUANCE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED')

        def remaining():
            value = remaining_seconds()
            need(type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value) and value > 0,
                 'PROBE_AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED')
            return value

        deadline = self.clock() + min(10, remaining())
        need(self.sa_uid(timeout=min(self.budget(deadline), remaining())) == expected_uid,
             'SA_CHANGED_BEFORE_ISSUE')
        timeout = min(self.budget(deadline), remaining())
        self.issue_uid, self.attempted = expected_uid, True
        body = encode({
            'apiVersion': 'authentication.k8s.io/v1', 'kind': 'TokenRequest',
            'metadata': {'name': 'cicd-runner-sa', 'namespace': 'ci-cd', 'uid': expected_uid},
            'spec': {'audiences': [b.AUDIENCE], 'expirationSeconds': TTL},
        })
        obj = token = None
        try:
            obj = b.read(self.request(TOKEN_ARGS, payload=body, timeout=timeout).stdout)
            need(obj.get('apiVersion') == 'authentication.k8s.io/v1'
                 and obj.get('kind') == 'TokenRequest', 'TOKEN_REQUEST_OBJECT_INVALID')
            meta, spec, status = obj['metadata'], obj['spec'], obj['status']
            need(meta.get('name') == 'cicd-runner-sa' and meta.get('namespace') == 'ci-cd'
                 and meta.get('uid') == expected_uid and spec.get('audiences') == [b.AUDIENCE]
                 and not spec.get('boundObjectRef')
                 and type(spec.get('expirationSeconds')) is int
                 and 0 < spec['expirationSeconds'] <= TTL, 'TOKEN_REQUEST_BINDING_INVALID')
            token, status_time = status['token'], status['expirationTimestamp']
            claims = c.claims_checked(token, expected_uid)
            stamp = expiry(status_time)
            # Kubernetes records status time before constructing JWT NumericDates.
            # Their expiries need not equal; enforce the earlier authenticated bound.
            need(claims['exp'] - claims['iat'] <= spec['expirationSeconds']
                 and claims['iat'] < stamp.timestamp() <= claims['exp'],
                 'TOKEN_REQUEST_EXPIRY_INVALID')
            return {'token': token, 'sa_uid': expected_uid,
                    'status_expires_at': stamp.isoformat()}
        finally:
            obj = token = None

    def review(self, token, audience, timeout):
        need(self.attempted and audience == b.AUDIENCE, 'NATIVE_REVIEW_SCOPE_INVALID')
        deadline = self.clock() + a.timeout_checked(timeout)
        need(self.sa_uid(timeout=self.budget(deadline)) == self.issue_uid,
             'SA_CHANGED_BEFORE_REVIEW')
        return super().review(token, audience, self.budget(deadline))


def attributes(verb, resource, namespace='', name='', group='apps', *, subresource=''):
    obj = {'verb': verb, 'resource': resource, 'group': group, 'version': 'v1'}
    if namespace:
        obj['namespace'] = namespace
    if name:
        obj['name'] = name
    if subresource:
        obj['subresource'] = subresource
    return obj


RBAC_TESTS = tuple(
    (attributes(verb, 'deployments', 'fds-app', name), True)
    for name in a.NAMES for verb in ('get', 'update', 'patch')
) + (
    (attributes('create', 'deployments', 'fds-app'), False),
    (attributes('delete', 'deployments', 'fds-app', 'transaction-api'), False),
    (attributes('patch', 'deployments', 'fds-app', 'unapproved-probe'), False),
    (attributes('patch', 'deployments', 'default', 'transaction-api'), False),
    (attributes('get', 'secrets', 'fds-app', group=''), False),
    (attributes('list', 'pods', 'fds-app', group=''), False),
    (attributes('create', 'tokenreviews', group='authentication.k8s.io'), False),
    # Query authorization only: no Role/RoleBinding write or exec request is sent.
    (attributes('create', 'roles', 'fds-app', group='rbac.authorization.k8s.io'), False),
    (attributes('patch', 'roles', 'fds-app', 'cicd-deploy-updater',
